diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says VCC, datasheet reading says RST
diffs.evidence: Schematic P1 pin 1 = VDD. DFRobot SEN0330 schematic V1.0 (2019/12/16), connector P1: pin 1 = VDD, pin 2 = GND (ground symbol), pin 3 = SCL, pin 4 = SDA, pin 5 = INT, pin 6 = RST. The back-of-board photo (https://dfimg.dfrobot.com/enshop/SEN0330_Back_03.jpg) agrees: the square pin-1 pad sits under the VCC label at the right end; read from the back left-to-right the labels are RST, INT, SDA, SCL, GND, VCC, i.e. pins 6..1. The second reading numbered from the wrong end.
